methodology: Static code audit + cProfile + MLX microbenchmarks at 4K-64K contexts
sandbox_note: Claude Code sandbox blocks Metal GPU; disabled for .venv/bin/python per user sandbox exclusion

exp1_wht_vs_dense_rotation.finding: Dense matmul 26x faster than Python WHT at 262K vectors
exp1_wht_vs_dense_rotation.implication: AMX matmul dominates Python butterfly loop overhead

exp2_scatter_vectorization.finding: .at[].add() loop 264x slower than vectorized scatter at 16K

exp3_freshness_vectorized.finding: Vectorized triangular mask gives 1.5-2.5x but scatter loop remains bottleneck
exp3_freshness_vectorized.implication: Need fully vectorized scatter OR custom Metal kernel for full speedup

exp4_sdpa_vs_manual_importance.implication: SDPA overhead at small T, but wins on both speed and memory at 16K+

exp5_duokv_concat_vs_slab_48layers.finding: Pre-allocated slab 18.2x faster at 16K across 48 layers
exp5_duokv_concat_vs_slab_48layers.implication: Concat at 16K limits decode to 24 tok/s (below Goal 3). Slab fixes it.

exp6_fused_dequant.finding: Fused dequant 2.0-2.5x faster, trivial to enable

exp7_dense_quantize.finding: Dense matmul quantize 2.5-3x faster than Python WHT quantize

exp8_sdpa_peak_memory.finding: SDPA saves 99% peak memory vs manual GQA expansion

exp10_dense_quality_warning.finding: CRITICAL: naive R.T substitution produces 100% wrong indices
exp10_dense_quality_warning.root_cause: Forward rotation is H @ diag(signs) @ x, not (diag(signs) @ H).T @ x

exp10_dense_quality_warning.finding: Naive R.T substitution produces 100% wrong packed indices — sign ordering matters

exp12_wht_pass_breakdown.finding: 7 butterfly passes each cost 4-20ms due to reshape+stack+eval kernel dispatches

exp13_eval_overhead.finding: mx.eval() costs 0.746ms even for trivial ops. 48L × 2 evals = 71ms/decode token

exp14_concat_vs_inplace_16K.finding: mx.concatenate 445x slower than in-place at 16K context

exp15_goal1_budget.finding: 3-bit native fits 1.5M tokens (Goal 1 achievable). DuoKV fp16 only fits 305K. DuoKV needs quantized retrieval heads for 1M.
